# The vocabulary

Every word Faro uses for a state, defined once in `src/domain/vocabulary.ts`. The **code** is what is stored, passed and returned by the rules (and in the conformance data); the **word** is what people read. Stored codes never change. **Rule** is the function that decides it, as `file#function` under `src/domain`. **Where** says where it may appear: screens, exports, Help and the AI assistant.

## A goal’s status

Group `status`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `on` | On track | At least 95% of the progress planned by now, inside its limit, or every stage on schedule. If the recent trend says it will still finish short, it is flagged as getting worse. | `status#goalStatus` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `risk` | At risk | 80%–95% of the progress planned by now, inside a limit’s warning margin or over it for one week, or a stage up to 2 weeks late. The owner says how it gets back: its path to green. | `status#goalStatus` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `off` | Off track | Under 80% of the progress planned by now, a stage more than 2 weeks late, or over a limit two weeks running. It needs a decision, help or a new plan. | `status#goalStatus` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `stale` | No recent update | The latest check-in was posted 14 days ago or more (or, with none at all, the goal began that long ago). Its last call, numbers and forecast are out of date until the owner checks in. Never said: “No recent check-in”, “gone quiet”, “goes quiet”, “An update is overdue”, “update is overdue”, “no check-in for 2+ weeks”, “Quiet for”. | `status#goalStatus` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `none` | No check-in yet | The goal has begun and nobody has checked in on it yet. 14 days after it began with still none, it has no recent update. Never said: “Waiting for its first check-in”, “Nothing reported yet”. | `status#goalStatus` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `planned` | Not started | Week 0: the goal is set up and its first check-in is due in week 1. | `status#goalStatus` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `done` | Done | The owner called it done in a check-in. Done means finished wherever it is said: a goal, a stage or an action. | `status#goalStatus` | screens, exports, help, ai |

## What needs attention, and why

Group `flag`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `off` | Off track | Under 80% of the progress planned by now, a stage more than 2 weeks late, or over a limit two weeks running. It needs a decision, help or a new plan. Same meaning as `status.off`. | `attention#attentionFor` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `risk` | At risk | 80%–95% of the progress planned by now, inside a limit’s warning margin or over it for one week, or a stage up to 2 weeks late. The owner says how it gets back: its path to green. Same meaning as `status.risk`. | `attention#attentionFor` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `stale` | No recent update | The latest check-in was posted 14 days ago or more (or, with none at all, the goal began that long ago). Its last call, numbers and forecast are out of date until the owner checks in. Same meaning as `status.stale`. | `attention#attentionFor` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `decision` | Decision or help needed | An open ask for a decision or help on the goal (its own, or one it is linked to). It stops counting once it is answered or withdrawn. | `asks#openFor` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `no-path` | No path to green | The latest check-in is off track or at risk and has no path to green: what changes, the week it is back on plan by, and any decision or help needed. Never said: “No recovery plan”. | `attention#attentionFor` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `missed-path` | Missed its own date | The path to green named a week to be back on plan by, that week has passed, and the goal is still off track or at risk. Never said: “Missed path to green”. | `attention#attentionFor` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `trend` | Getting worse | A number further behind its plan (in the goal’s own units) at each of the last two of 3 check-ins, and visibly so: behind now as shown, and further behind than at the first of them; a number moving towards its limit two check-ins running; a stage expected later than it was at the check-in before; or on track today with the whole projected range falling short of the target. The goal’s trend, its chart and its scorecard use the same rule. Never said: “Worsening trend”, “Falling further behind”, “Losing ground on the plan”, “and slipping”, “Moving towards the limit”. | `trend#gapTrend` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `greener` | Greener than calculated | The owner called it greener than the app calculates from the numbers. A greener call needs a reason, which is shown beside it. Never said: “Called greener than the numbers”, “greener than the numbers”. | `status#goalStatus` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `due` | Check-in due | The goal has no check-in for this week yet, before the review. It is listed for the owner, but on its own it doesn’t make the goal need attention. | `attention#attentionFor` | screens, help, ai |

## Needs attention and being handled

Group `attention`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `needs` | Needs attention | A goal needs attention when it is off track, missed its own date, no recent update, decision or help needed, no path to green, at risk, getting worse or greener than calculated, unless someone is already handling it. The same rule picks the goals on Home, in Watching, on the map, in the Goals filter, in reviews and for the AI assistant. | `attention#needsAttention` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `handled` | Being handled | Off track or at risk, and since its latest check-in someone other than the owner marked it reviewed or noted it, an action was agreed (and isn’t overdue), or its request was answered. A new check-in or a new flag makes it need attention again. | `attention#handledFor` | screens, exports, help, ai |

## Other warnings on a goal’s story

Group `warning`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slipped` | Date slipped | While it has been behind, the week its path to green names has moved later than the first one given. Never said: “Recovery date slipped”. | `story#storyOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `same-cause` | Same cause again | Behind, with the same cause given at each of its last three check-ins. | `story#storyOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `missed-quarter` | Last quarter not met | In a goal year: at the end of the last quarter it was worse than its own plan said it would be (short of it, or over it when lower is better), compared at the goal’s decimals. | `year#quarterResults` | screens, exports, help, ai |

## Which way it’s heading

Group `trend`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `worse` | Getting worse | A number further behind its plan (in the goal’s own units) at each of the last two of 3 check-ins, and visibly so: behind now as shown, and further behind than at the first of them; a number moving towards its limit two check-ins running; a stage expected later than it was at the check-in before; or on track today with the whole projected range falling short of the target. The goal’s trend, its chart and its scorecard use the same rule. Same meaning as `flag.trend`. | `trend#gapTrend` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `better` | Getting better | The opposite of getting worse, by the same rule: the gap to plan smaller (or the room to the limit larger) at each of the last two of 3 check-ins, or a stage expected sooner than at the check-in before. Never said: “Closing the gap”, “catching up”, “Gaining ground”, “Moving away from the limit”. | `trend#gapTrend` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `flat` | No steady trend | Not the same way at each of the last two of 3 check-ins (or fewer than 3 to go on), so neither getting worse nor getting better. | `trend#gapTrend` | screens, ai |

## Against the plan

Group `gap`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `behind` | behind plan | The latest number against the plan for its own week, in the goal’s units, said the same whichever way is better. Never said: “below week-”, “above week-”, “On the week-”. | `format#gapText` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `ahead` | ahead of plan | The latest number against the plan for its own week, in the goal’s units, said the same whichever way is better. | `format#gapText` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `on-plan` | On plan | The latest number is the plan for its week, as written to the goal’s decimals. | `format#gapText` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `reached` | Target reached | The latest number is at or past the target, or every stage is done. It is a gap, not a result: the result comes when the goal is due. | `format#gapText` | screens, exports, help, ai |

## A goal’s result, once it’s due

Group `result`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `completed` | Met | Reached the target (stayed in range, or finished every stage) by its due week, or the owner called it done by then. Never said: “Completed”. | `story#goalResult` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `late` | Met late | Reached the target (or finished every stage) after its due week. Never said: “Completed late”. | `story#goalResult` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `missed` | Not met | Its due week passed without reaching the target (or staying in range, or finishing every stage). Never said: “Did not meet”. | `story#goalResult` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `open` | Not finished yet | Its due week hasn’t passed and the owner hasn’t called it done, so it has no result yet. | `story#goalResult` | screens, ai |

## Each quarter of a goal year

Group `quarter`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `met` | Met | A quarter’s target is the plan’s number at its end (or the stages due by then, or staying in range). Met: it was there or better, compared at the goal’s decimals, so a number shown equal to its plan is met. Same meaning as `result.completed`. | `year#quarterResults` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `missed` | Not met | At the quarter’s end it was worse than where its plan said it would be, compared at the goal’s decimals (equal is met), or had no number to show. Same meaning as `result.missed`. Never said: “Missed its plan”, “Missed last quarter”. | `year#quarterResults` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `open` | In progress | The quarter hasn’t ended, so it is neither met nor not met yet. | `year#quarterResults` | screens, exports, help, ai |

| `partly` | Partly | What the owner says at the wrap-up. It is their view, shown as “Owner’s view”, and never changes the result. | `cycle#suggestedResult` | screens, exports, help, ai |

## A dated stage

Group `stage`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `done` | Done | The stage is finished, in the week the owner said it was. Same meaning as `status.done`. | `status#assessMilestone` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `planned` | On schedule | Not done yet, and expected by its due week. | `status#assessMilestone` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `risk` | Slipping | Not done, and now expected 1–2 weeks after its due week. A stage slipping makes the goal at risk. | `status#assessMilestone` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `off` | Late | Not done, and now expected more than 2 weeks after its due week. A late stage makes the goal off track. | `status#assessMilestone` | screens, exports, help, ai |

## Kinds of ask

Group `askKind`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `decision` | Decision or help | A decision or help an owner needs from someone. Open until it is answered or withdrawn. | `asks#asksOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `update` | Update | Someone asked the owner to check in. Open until they do (or answer it), or it is withdrawn. | `asks#asksOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `question` | Question | A question for the owner, often from a review. Open until it is answered or withdrawn. | `asks#asksOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `action` | Action | Something to do, agreed in a review, for someone, by a week. Marked done, never answered. | `asks#asksOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |

## Where an ask stands

Group `askStatus`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | Open | Nobody has answered it (an action: marked it done) or withdrawn it yet. | `asks#asksOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `answered` | Answered | Closed by its answer, which applies to every goal it is about. | `asks#isResolved` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `done` | Done | An action marked done by whoever does it, whoever agreed it, or an admin. Same meaning as `status.done`. | `asks#isResolved` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `withdrawn` | Withdrawn | No longer needed; the log keeps it. | `asks#asksOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `overdue` | Overdue | An ask with a due week, still open after that week. Only asks are overdue; a goal without a recent check-in has no recent update. | `asks#isOverdue` | screens, exports, help, ai |

## A review’s session

Group `session`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `not-started` | Not started | Nobody has marked a goal reviewed or said anything in this session yet. Same meaning as `status.planned`. | `review#sessionState` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `in-progress` | In progress | Something has been said or reviewed, but not every goal in the session. Same meaning as `quarter.open`. | `review#sessionState` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `held` | Held | Every goal in it has been marked reviewed; it was held on the day the last one was. | `review#sessionState` | screens, exports, help, ai |

## Removed, stopped and ended

Group `removal`.

| Code | Word | Meaning | Rule | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `left` | Left | Out of pickers, counts, reviews and Home; named in history as “Name (left)”. | `removal#markPersonLeft` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `stopped` | Stopped | Out of every list, still on its own page, in exports and in Activity, with when, by whom and why. | `removal#stopGoal` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `ended` | Ended | An ended review keeps everything said in it, and is no longer due or listed. | `removal#endReview` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `removed` | Removed | Taken away, never erased: it can be undone, and restored for 30 days under Recently removed. | `removal#recentlyRemoved` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `comment-removed` | Comment removed | A removed comment keeps its place in the thread, with these words. | `removal#commentsOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `note-removed` | Note removed | A removed review note keeps its place in the record, with these words. | `removal#commentsOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |
| `edited` | edited | The words were corrected after they were posted; the log keeps the before and after. | `removal#commentsOf` | screens, exports, help, ai |
